instrument.method: full chain replayed from scratch (v1 through v13, each internal version guard enforced in sequence) on a fresh disposable branch, then a live psql session bound to the non-BYPASSRLS supermega_trial_backend role via GUC identity (app.workspace_id/app.actor_id/app.actor_kind), matching the runtime's real connection shape

roleAttributesConfirmedUnchanged.note: SET option was granted to postgres temporarily (via the ADMIN option v4 already grants it) only to open a session as the runtime role for this proof, then revoked immediately after; final state verified identical to the v4-guarded baseline.

findings: rls_enabled_no_policy on app_private.billing_events (expected: deny-by-default, founder-only forever)
rls_enabled_no_policy on app_private.billing_invoices (expected: deny-by-default, founder-only forever)

verdict: billing_entitlements_self_read policy proven on real hosted Postgres 17: a session bound to one workspace reads only that workspace's entitlement row, cannot see another workspace's row even when directly queried, cannot write (insert/update/delete all denied), and billing_invoices/billing_events remain completely dark to the runtime role. Migration v13 is safe to apply to production as its own founder decision, separate from v12.
